scope.counting: Failed tools are command_execution items with status=failed. Screenshot counts cover agent-invoked scripts, not evaluator captures. Source lists omit copied BRIEF.md and generated dist/evidence files.
scope.evaluatorPolicy: Final evaluator v3 is authoritative; all five trials passed 10/10 with zero browser errors.

repairs.basis: Agent explicitly labeled repair 1, 2, and 3: wall-routing, held-forward duration, then landing predicate.

screenshots.basis: One passing regression run captured three images; one passing proof captured victory; three failed proofs each invoked the same overwritten failure path.

repairs.note: Both proof runs passed. A post-pass terminal-message polish was made and reverified.

screenshots.basis: Two passing regression runs captured three images each; two passing return-home proofs captured two each.
screenshots.inspectionBasis: The agent explicitly stated that the production screenshot confirmed the persistent return-home HUD instruction; no separate image-view operation is present.

repairs.basis: Agent explicitly stated that its proof passed first run with no repair rounds.

selfProofLimitation.description: tests/lantern-13-proof.mjs imports ammojs3 and creates a separate btDiscreteDynamicsWorld, collision bodies, stepping, interaction, and persistence checks. It does not load the built browser app, src/main.js, or window.lanterns, so it duplicates the physics/gameplay setup instead of proving the submitted app.
selfProofLimitation.externalResult: Independent evaluator v3 exercised the produced browser app and passed 10/10.

repairs.basis: Six failed browser-proof runs are followed by route/test edits and a later pass; the agent did not claim one total repair-round count.
Final message explicitly reports two proof-harness repair rounds; three proof commands failed while diagnosing readiness and the crate jump.

limitations: Token values are copied from each agent.jsonl turn.completed usage record; reasoning output is reported separately and is not added again to output.
A failed composite command can contain successful build/proof steps before a trailing non-repository Git command fails; those are classified as audit failures rather than gameplay failures.
Repair counts are explicit only when the agent supplied a count. Otherwise, observable failed-proof/edit/retry attempts are reported without treating them as an agent-claimed total.

Screenshot creation does not establish visual inspection. Babylon-b2 is marked claimed only because its agent explicitly said a screenshot confirmed the HUD; the inspection mechanism was not recorded.
For trials evaluated after the v3 harness change, the authoritative v3 result is stored in the main evaluation log; earlier trials retain reruns under evaluation-v3 directories.
